ticker: Cyclone Arnab approaches Andhra Pradesh coast with high winds.
India seals T20 series against New Zealand after crushing win.
Indian court orders takedown of Modi-Adani documentary.
Nvidia commits $3 billion to Meta's new share offering.
India begins Asian Champions Trophy title defence with 13-0 win.

articles.headline: Indian Court Orders Takedown of Modi and Adani Documentary
articles.brief: The Calcutta High Court has ordered major social media platforms to remove a 36-minute documentary concerning Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Gautam Adani. Hotmail co-founder Sabeer Bhatia also faces a significant defamation suit in connection with the controversial release.

articles.headline: India Deploys Extra Forces Following Escalating Border Dam Protests
articles.brief: Authorities in India have deployed additional security forces to manage rising protests and tensions surrounding a contentious dam project located near the Chinese border, as local opposition continues to escalate.

articles.headline: Delhi Invites Pakistan Minister for SCO Civilisational Dialogue
articles.brief: In a significant diplomatic move, India has invited a Pakistani minister to attend the inaugural SCO Civilisational Dialogue in New Delhi. Prime Minister Modi is set to inaugurate the high-profile event featuring delegates from over 25 countries.

articles.headline: Cyclone Arnab Threatens Andhra Pradesh With Heavy Rains and Winds
articles.brief: Cyclone Arnab is barreling towards the Andhra Pradesh coast, prompting widespread disaster preparations, flight cancellations, and the hoisting of high-danger signals at major ports as coastal districts brace for severe impact.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu Makes Digital Payments Mandatory for Large Liquor Purchases
articles.brief: The Tamil Nadu State Marketing Corporation has announced that digital payments via UPI, debit, and credit cards will become mandatory for all retail liquor purchases exceeding ₹1,000 starting November 1, aimed at enhancing transparency and financial accountability.

articles.headline: GST Rules on Post-Sale Discounts and Refunds to Shift in November
articles.brief: Businesses across India will navigate revised goods and services tax regulations starting November 1, as authorities implement updated frameworks addressing post-sale discounts, export refunds, and registration timelines to ease tax dispute resolutions.

articles.headline: India Issues National Alert Over Counterfeit Defitelio Supply
articles.brief: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organization has issued a strict safety alert to drug inspectors nationwide following warnings from the World Health Organization regarding a circulating batch of counterfeit Defitelio medications.

articles.headline: Nvidia Commits $3 Billion to Meta Share Offering and AI Partnership
articles.brief: Tech giants Nvidia and Meta have deepened their strategic partnership, with Nvidia committing $3 billion toward Meta's new share offering while expanding collaborative efforts on advanced AI assistant technologies.

articles.headline: India Eclipses $850 Million in Arms Exports to European Markets
articles.brief: Amid ongoing global conflicts, India's defense sector has experienced an unprecedented surge, exporting over $850 million worth of weapons and ammunition to European nations eager to restock military supplies.

articles.headline: Defence Council Approves Project 18A for Next-Generation Destroyers
articles.brief: The Indian Defence Acquisition Council has greenlit the massive Project 18A, a multi-billion-rupee initiative aimed at designing and constructing bigger, heavier, and stealthier next-generation destroyers for the Indian Navy.

articles.headline: India Crushes Bangladesh 13-0 in Asian Champions Trophy Opener
articles.brief: Defending champions India launched their Asian Champions Trophy hockey campaign with a dominant 13-0 victory over Bangladesh, featuring a stellar hat-trick from striker Mandeep Singh.

articles.headline: Abhishek Century Seals T20 Series Victory for India Over New Zealand
articles.brief: An explosive century from opener Abhishek Sharma powered India to a comprehensive victory over New Zealand, comfortably sealing the T20 international series with dominant performances across disciplines.

articles.headline: Ex-RBI Chief Rajan Warns Against Depleting Reserves to Defend Rupee
articles.brief: Former Reserve Bank of India Governor Raghuram Rajan has advised that monetary authorities should avoid aggressively depleting foreign exchange reserves to artificially defend the rupee against currency fluctuations.

articles.headline: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Exits Impacting Global Workforce Staff
articles.brief: Microsoft has introduced a sweeping voluntary exit program for a significant portion of its global workforce, raising concerns and questions regarding potential operational impacts on its massive employee base in India.

articles.headline: Record Turnout Reported as Israeli Voters Deliver Verdict on Netanyahu
articles.brief: Israelis turned out in record numbers to cast their ballots amid high regional tensions, fresh trauma from ongoing multi-front conflicts, and intense public scrutiny over security and political accountability.
